listing.name: Tri-Ceti
listing.summary: Tri-Ceti - A triad of mini factions
listing.aiSummary: Adds three new tiny factions with their own star systems, ships, fighters, and backgrounds.

description:
Tri-Ceti - A triad of mini factions
Download v1.0.2g
v1.0.2g is save compatible with v1.0.2d or higher, but NOT LOWER.
This is only because of sector generation, not a bug. If you patch it regardless, it shouldn't crash but not have the new system parts.

Requires
LazyLib
MagicLib
Nexerelin

Features:

3 new tiny factions
A star system for each faction
Total of 21 new ships and 6 new fighters
Built-in hullmods for each faction according to their lore and style
3 backgrounds for Nexerelin to further customize your experience and start with the faction blueprints
1 MagicLib bounty and a ship variant for it
Player exclusive portraits fitting the factions - only the player can have those portraits, not the player faction thanks to Nes

Their systems are fairly close to each other in the bottom right of the sector, close to the Abyss but not inside the movement penalty area. The system positions are based on the sector dimensions. If a mod like Wide Horizons is used, they remain in the same corner, have the same distance from each other and from the Abyss but a greater distance from the Core Worlds.

Ossa, the Cetevska system, is now visible on the sector map thanks to Klark Morrigan!

Faction and Ship Preview
Faction descriptions from in game and a few ships to show their style

Cetora

Lore
Only sheer willpower and the support of its AI taskmaster ensured the survival of Cetora. In an endless war against their treacherous neighbours, Cetora settled in a remote system close to the edge of the Orion-Perseus Abyss. With their ingenuity, despite a lack of personnel and material, Cetora designed infrastructure and ships with a focus on reusability and recyclability. Nothing goes to waste in Cetoran society, as nothing can be spared. This resulted not only in an efficient ship doctrine but also in a somewhat horrific treatment of their own populace, seeking to get as much use out of everything and everyone as possible.
Their creed reflects this: «Only the relentless survive.»

Ships
Cetora is all about mitigating combat cost. They have built-in salvaging drones able to heal them mid-combat, increased weapon range, increased repair bonus out of combat and reduced maintenance. Their ships use frontal engines to quickly turn or slow down.

Bekos
This salvaging ship is the smaller hull carrying Dusios drones. It is salvage ship, freighter and 'healer' at the same time.

Nertos
A Cetoran broadside cruiser.

Cetudan

Lore
Failure is an inevitable step toward progress. Better, however, if someone else bears the cost. Such is the philosophy of Cetudan. Ruled by an AI-directed conglomerate of corporations, with the AI CEO standing at its apex, Cetudan has cultivated immense prosperity in the far reaches of the Persean Sector. Driven by relentless innovation, AI-assisted research, and an uncompromising willingness to explore the unknown, the conglomerate remains at the forefront of technological advancement. Every failed experiment is merely another investment in future success. Yet progress comes at a price. Fiercely protective of its discoveries and suspicious of rivals, Cetudan guards its technology with ruthless efficiency. Its vast wealth supports a growing population and an equally formidable military. While the privileged command fleets and oversee corporate domains, the destitute are offered a different future: to surrender their humanity in exchange for becoming the conglomerate’s latest generation of mechanized soldiers.

Ships
Cetudan ships rely on improved shields, speed, their energy weapon focus, reduced venting time and their carrier doctrine to offset their extremely low hull and armor.

Mir
The Cetudan freighter, not meant for combat.

Cheondo
The capital carrier of Cetudan able to field 5 wings.

Cetevska

Lore
Hardship can be overcome through the guidance of a mighty AI. Such is the way of Cetevska. To not merely survive the dangers of the Persean Sector, but to transcend them, Cetevska has mastered the manipulation of biology to suit its will. Their AI Thearch promises ascension by biogenic augmentation, a path beyond the limits of ordinary humanity. Over generations, this doctrine transformed this isolated faction on the edge of the Orion-Perseus Abyss into a society that reshapes flesh without restraint. Steel and living tissue are fused into grotesque machines, their ships grown as much as they are built. Viewing all who reject ascension and serfdom to their Thearch as lesser beings, Cetevska wages war with a fanatical zeal that rivals even the Luddic Path and the sector’s most ruthless pirates.

Ships
Cetevska uses grown ship parts that allow them to constantly heal mid-combat at a slow rate and use less crew. Their ships have extremely low armor though and their shields are subpar. They have moving arms on their ships to help with logistics of their quasi-living ships.

Ezyk
The smaller Cetevska combat freighter.

Rog
The mainline brawling ship used in Cetevska fleets.

All 3 backgrounds add a hidden skill. I have it set to hidden so it won't move around skill trees, especially considering the compatibility with popular skill mods like Second in Command. There might be a fix for this I am not aware of. The backgrounds should only affect the following though.

Nexerelin Backgrounds
Neural Logistics Interface

Increases command point amount and regeneration, reduces movement penalty on campaign map but reduces peak performance time.

Reflex Accelerator

Increases weapon turn rate and reduces ship system charge time and general ship system cooldown. Reduces the combat readiness on your flagship.

Biogenesis

Increases peak performance time by 60s with no downside.

Special Thanks to
Alex & David for the amazing game and art
LazyWizard for LazyLib
LazyWizard for Console Commands to help test the mod
Tartiflette & Wispborne for MagicLib
Histidine & Zaphide for Nexerelin
SeverianVoid for the AI models used for portraits and industry pictures
Klark Morrigan for the help with setting up a visible Abyss rogue planet system
Sinosauropteryx for the tutorial on module black magic
Nes for helping to set up player exclusive portraits

Bass, BinBin96 & Vexlia Artemiss among many others from the Discord for art feedback

The faction music was made with Suno AI and Audacity

Changelog

Spoiler
v1.0.2g
Added Patrol HQ to Ossa markets (Only for new games / Nex should build it on old saves anyway)
v1.0.2f
Added faction music
v1.0.2e
Fixed Ossa visibility on sector map
Fixed built-in hullmods not being hidden and thus being obtainable
v1.0.2d
Added an additional Cetora system plagued by remnants
Added a stable location to Ossa
v1.0.2c
Added background to Ossa
Improved ship survivability of Cetudan and Cetevska
v1.0.2b
Added new portraits
Changed Nexerelin background pictures
Fixed Soteria jump point being inside the star
v1.0.2
Added new colonies to balance the factions' economy
Added Magic Bounty and a new ship variant for it
Changed descriptions being too long
Changed buff from their market condition from 50 to 35 accessability to counteract Abyss
Fixed Nexerelin profiles not working
Fixed a cyborg portrait having a glowing background
v1.0.1b
Added 4 new portraits
Fixed descriptions not working
Fixed abandoned stations not being available for storage
v1.0.1
Added a planetary condition to counteract terrible accessability due to proximity of the 3 systems to the Abyss
Enabled diplomacy for Cetevska in Nexerelin
Increased max relation of the 3 factions with vanilla factions so they can become neutral with some
Fixed Mita crash due to wing size
Fixed fighter tags
Fixed codex tags
Buffed Mita to compensate for wing size
v1.0.0b
Enabled Version Checker and changed colony sizes
v1.0.0
Release

discordPostHtml:
I decided to post it on the discord, so more people get to test the mod and potentially help me fix more. And if anyone likes it, even better.

The mod adds 3 small factions to the game in the bottom right of the sector, always bordering the Abyss as their position is relative to the sector size. They are different in style and playability. Cetudan has fast carriers with no hull or armor. Cetora has salvaging ships with a healing drone 'harvesting' enemies in combat and reduced maintenance cost outside of combat. Cetevska has bioships healing constantly like the skill Combat Endurance but with no cap. To counteract that, they have increased crew casualties.

Link to the forum page: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=35831.0

I didn't quite know how to add a picture to this so take a screenshot of my Krita-File. The forward facing engines of Cetora and the moving arms of Cetevska are, obviously, not visible on the sprite sheet. You can see the arm parts separately and imagine it :^)
aiDescription: Adds three new tiny factions, each with its own star system located near the Orion-Perseus Abyss. The mod introduces 21 new ships and 6 new fighters, along with faction-specific hullmods and Nexerelin backgrounds that provide unique skills. Each faction has distinct lore and combat doctrines, ranging from salvaging and recycling to AI-driven corporate expansion and biological augmentation.
